executive_assessment.text: The CCDR identifies Indigenous peoples, Afro-descendants and women as disproportionately vulnerable to climate impacts in Honduras.
The CCDR recommends tenure security, livelihood diversification, locally led investment and resilient rural roads to protect vulnerable groups.
